Phonicademy 44 Sounds Audio Pack
https://phonicademy.com/printables/phonics-audio-pack

49 short MP3 files, one per letter sound (44 English sounds; some sounds
have two spellings, e.g. c and k). Each file is the pure sound ("sss", not "ess"),
in the same teaching order as the free study plan:

 1. phonemes/s.mp3           "s"  /s/     as in sun
 2. phonemes/a.mp3           "a"  /æ/     as in ant
 3. phonemes/t.mp3           "t"  /t/     as in tap
 4. phonemes/p.mp3           "p"  /p/     as in pan
 5. phonemes/i.mp3           "i"  /ɪ/     as in ink

How to use
- Play one new sound three times, then say it together with its action.
- In the car, play the sounds learned so far and call out a word that starts with each one.
- Make a playlist of only the tricky sounds and play it for a minute before each session.
- Pair each file with its flashcard or mouth-shape card (free at phonicademy.com/printables).
